_comment: Animal Mounts: 16 subspecies across 5 breeds, 17 paired abilities and 18 spawn points. Every figure traces to one forum thread, which is why the rows are labelled community-reported rather than cross-checked.

_mechanics.value: Animal Mounts are a Cai-only world map mechanic.
_mechanics.sourceNote: game8 and the community write-up agree on the Cai restriction.

_mechanics.value: Unlocks on Cai's Part I route at Chapter 5.
Animal tiles appear on the world map. Selecting Lure places one food item; matching the species preference improves the odds.
_mechanics.sourceNote: Community write-up plus the Game8 capture page title.

_mechanics.value: After several turns the tile fills a capture gauge. Returning and choosing Capture plays a short scene.
A successful capture sends the animal to the stable in Lowtown, Dagsion.
A failed capture gives that animal's manure, which is used as crop fertiliser.
Assigning a unit to care for and feed an animal in the stable raises that unit's Bond Level with it, faster with preferred food.
A mount only unlocks its abilities for a unit in a matching mounted class: an Ornius pairs with an Ornius Rider.
The stable holds up to 200 animals, and extras can be released.
Players report the stable captures refresh daily, unlike most world map activities which are weekly.
_mechanics.sourceNote: Community write-up, reported rather than confirmed.

_mechanics.value: Rare spawns are reported at roughly a 70 common to 30 rare split, and players report being able to shift the result by reloading and changing how many times a tile is searched.
_mechanics.sourceNote: Community write-up, single-poster and explicitly described as imprecise.

_mechanics.value: Each Bond Level grants +1 point in a stat and +5 percent growth in a stat, so Bond 5 is +5 points and +25 percent.
_mechanics.sourceNote: Serenes Forest thread, corroborated by several posters inside the same thread.

_mechanics.value: Bucephalus, Alexandra's unique mount, and Rocinan, Io's, cap at six reward points instead of five, giving +6 points and +30 percent.
_mechanics.sourceNote: Serenes Forest thread, two posters agree.

_mechanics.value: The stat point and the growth percentage rarely apply to the same stat, so a mount can raise Speed as a flat bonus while raising Dexterity growth.
Players report the Charioteer class doubles the growth bonus a mount provides, and attribute it to its Charioteer's Path skill; the thread treats the mechanism as unresolved.
_mechanics.sourceNote: Serenes Forest thread, described there as not settled.

_mechanics.value: Io and Alexandra carry paired mounts of their own, and one poster states those bonuses apply on other routes too, with bonding slower away from the stable.
_mechanics.sourceNote: Single poster, and it conflicts with the Cai-only framing elsewhere; both are kept.

_openQuestions: The exact figures for White Ornius, Wild Pegasus and every Elephant entry.
What Paired Magic-Focus does beyond the name, which one poster guesses is a magic hit rate boost.
Which bait gives the best odds on a rare spawn, which the thread asks and leaves unanswered.
Whether battalions also grant growth bonuses on Theodora's route, which one poster asks and nobody confirms.
Whether the Charioteer growth doubling is a real effect or a display artefact, which the thread itself calls unresolved.
How Rocinan is obtained, and whether recruiting Io is required for it.
_sourcing: Primary source: the Serenes Forest thread titled Mounts give bonus stats AND growth rates, started by Nakai with a table compiled by Mujin and additions from several posters. The fortunesweave.co.uk mount page states that it republishes those same figures, so it is recorded as a secondary reference rather than an independent source.
